title: macOS launcher fix and versioned release assets
highlights: Release assets now embed the version in the filename (e.g. IDEOCODE-v0.64.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz and IDEOCODE-gui-v0.64.1-macos-aarch64.dmg), so the TUI and GUI ship distinct, versioned artifacts for every platform.
The updater, installers, Homebrew, and AUR all follow the new naming, and existing installs update cleanly from v0.64.0.
improvements: The macOS launcher no longer maintains the legacy app-launcher directory, removing the code path that forced a launcher refresh on every launch and app-switch after the rebrand.
TUI test helpers for terminal launch and env-var scoping are gated to Unix, so the test suite compiles and runs on Windows.
fixes: IDEOCODE on macOS no longer re-creates the .app launcher every time it launches after the IDEOCODE rebrand.
Clippy -D warnings in ideocode-app-core tooling are resolved.
